title: Lifesaver
description: Lifesaver adds simple, readable combat announcements for moments where players step in for each other.
body:
Lifesaver adds server chat announcements for moments where players protect or save each other in combat.

When a player is hurt by another player, a hostile mob, an optional neutral mob, a projectile, TNT, an area effect cloud, or another Bukkit-supported entity damage source, Lifesaver tracks the responsible attacker for a short time. If another player finishes that attacker off or has valid recent kill credit, the plugin can announce it as a protection. If the victim was left on low health, it can announce it as a stronger save.

## Features

- Announces when a player protects someone from a recent attacker
- Announces stronger save messages when the victim was close to death
- Tracks player attackers, hostile mobs, and optional neutral mobs
- Resolves projectiles, TNT, evoker fangs, area effect clouds, and similar Bukkit-exposed sources back to the responsible entity where Bukkit supports it
- Can credit tamed mob damage or kills to the online owner
- Supports grouped victim messages or one recent save-focused message
- Configurable save health threshold, absorption handling, tracking time, victim history size, and kill credit timing
- Per-player cooldowns for protectors and victims to stop repeated message spam
- World blacklist or whitelist support
- Ignores creative, spectator, dead, vanished, and NPC players
- Ignores Totem of Undying and similar self-resurrection saves
- Custom message text, colours, delivery mode, and console logging
- Optional protection and save rewards with separate commands, messages, and cooldowns
- Optional Bukkit event for integrations such as Alignments
- External announcement API for integrations such as Bodyguard

## Commands

`/lifesaver` shows the plugin version and how many attackers are currently being tracked.

`/lifesaver reload` reloads the configuration.

## Permissions

`lifesaver.use` allows use of the main command.

`lifesaver.reload` allows reloading the config.

## Notes

Lifesaver does not change combat damage, revive players, or give gameplay advantages by itself. It only watches combat events and gives players credit when they help someone survive.
